text: dsh-token-dashboard 是面向 DSH Web 的本地会话用量看板：插件从官方 sessionPersistence 与运行中的 sessions 读取会话数据，在 DSH 侧栏底部注册入口，并通过只读同源路由向界面提供聚合统计。看板按时间范围展示 Token 总量与趋势，可查看模型、会话和逐次请求记录，并按模型价格估算费用；费用可本地调整，也可选从 OpenRouter 刷新价目。适合想跨会话了解本地 DSH 用量的人。无需 API Key；在线价目查询会访问 OpenRouter。

dsh-token-dashboard is a local usage dashboard for DSH Web. It reads live and stored sessions and shows token totals, trends, models, sessions, and requests. It estimates costs from model prices, which can be edited locally or refreshed from OpenRouter. No API key is required.
我想把 DSH 各个本地会话的 Token 用量放在一起看。
有没有能按日期查看 Token 使用趋势的 DSH 看板？
I want to compare token usage across my local DSH sessions.
dsh-token-dashboard 的功能「跨会话用量看板」：从本地持久化记录和运行中的会话汇总用量，并在 Web 面板展示概览、模型、会话和请求视图。
dsh-token-dashboard 的功能「费用估算」：看板按模型价格估算费用，允许打开价格配置，也可触发从 OpenRouter 刷新在线价目；价格刷新为可选操作。
dsh-token-dashboard 使用前须知：在线刷新价格时会向 OpenRouter 请求公开模型价目，不需 API Key，代码未附加会话内容。（见 src/host/prices.ts:38-39, 101-125）

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 概览：DSH 已经能显示当前会话的 Token 用量，但看不到完整视图：所有项目、模型、子代理、分叉和请求分散在各个会话里。

`@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard` 补上的就是这一层，以 **Token 用量** 的形式作为原生插件运行。

Host 端通过官方 `sessionPersistence` 服务读取会话日志，并使用与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` 一致的四桶口径折叠数据。Client 端通过 DSH Slot 注册 `main` 面板和侧边栏 footer 入口，使用宿主提供的 React 运行时和主题 Token 渲染。

插件不会写入会话日志、修改模型请求或上传会话数据。会话日志始终是唯一事实来源。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 功能：- **全局用量视图**：当前 profile 下所有会话的总量、未缓存输入、输出、缓存读/写、请求数、缓存命中率和会话数。
- **时间范围联动**：今天、最近 7 / 30 / 90 天、全部时间或自定义日期范围；KPI 与 Usage 图表使用同一范围。
- **模型与会话**：可搜索、筛选、排序的分页表格，以及会话详情抽屉。
- **请求日志**：按每次计费请求展示时间、应用、供应商、模型、新增输入、输出、缓存命中、成本、速度和首字耗时。
- **费用估算**：内置 357 个 OpenRouter 模型快照与 DeepSeek 高峰价；可本地覆盖任意单价，也可按需从 OpenRouter 刷新。
- **原生与本地优先**：DSH Slot、主题 Token、中英文界面、同源只读路由；导出时自动去掉工作目录。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 快速开始：本项目包名为 **`@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard`**。当前请按下文从源码构建并作为本地 bundle 安装。npm 上不带 scope 的 `dsh-token-dashboard` 属于另一个项目，请勿使用 `npm install dsh-token-dashboard` 安装本插件。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 环境要求：- 可运行 Web UI 的 DeepSeek Harness。已在 DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.3`（Cordis `4.0.5`）验证。
- 从源码构建需要 Node.js **22.18 或更高版本** 和 `pnpm`。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 构建：```bash
git clone https://github.com/shi-YangYang/dsh-token-dashboard.git
cd dsh-token-dashboard
pnpm install
```

`pnpm install` 会通过 `prepare` 自动构建 Host 和 Client，生成不入库的 `lib/` 和 `client/`。修改源码后可运行 `pnpm build` 重新构建。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 安装到 DSH：在 DSH 的 **Plugins** 界面中选择本地 bundle 安装，目标指向本目录；也可以在 DSH Agent 中执行：

```text
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-token-dashboard")
```

如果 profile 中禁用了该 bundle，请启用，然后刷新 DSH Web 页面。在侧边栏底部、Settings 上方打开 **Token 用量**。

更新 Host 代码后需要重启 DSH；仅修改 Client 时刷新页面即可。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 使用：| 页面 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| **概览** | 所选范围内的全局 KPI 与 Usage 图表 |
| **模型** | 按供应商/模型统计的 Token 分布与请求数 |
| **会话** | 搜索、筛选、排序、分页和会话详情 |
| **请求日志** | 逐条计费请求，每页 12 条，最新在前 |
| **费用** | 预估总费用、逐模型明细、单价覆盖与在线价目刷新 |

顶部提供语言切换、扫描间隔、**立即同步**和导出。扫描间隔控制本地会话轮询：**5 / 10 / 30 / 60 秒**。所有列表每页最多 **12 行**，行高保持紧凑，分页位于卡片底部，不引入卡片或表格滚动条。

请求日志的成本按浏览器中的当前价目即时计算，未定价模型显示 `—`。速度 = 输出 Token / 实测请求窗口；首字 = `step/start` 到首个 stream record 的时间，没有 stream 时间戳时显示 `—`。
@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 使用：费用只是估算，不是 provider 账单。内置 DeepSeek 单价为高峰价，非高峰约为一半。单价覆盖和在线价目缓存保存在浏览器 `localStorage`。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 架构：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Logs[(会话日志)] --> Host[Host 聚合器]
  Live[session/event] --> Host
  Host --> Fold[Token fold + revision 缓存]

- **Host**（`src/host`）读取官方会话存储、增量折叠用量、处理价目并提供看板 API。缓存只在内存中，按会话 revision 或 live sequence 维护；没有第二个数据库或账本。
- **Client**（`src/client`）注册 `main` 与 `sidebar.footer.action` Slot，管理扫描间隔、语言和价目偏好，并渲染看板。React 由宿主提供，不会重复打包。
- **Shared**（`src/shared`）包含双方共用的 wire 类型、四桶运算、范围选择、价目和格式化。

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 架构：统计遵循 `tokenUsage` 的公开口径：四个互斥 provider 桶、同一次 attempt 的最终样本替换流式样本、重试开启新 attempt、分叉继承的前缀不计入总量。实现见 [`src/host/fold.ts`](./src/host/fold.ts)。

HTTP 接口只读且同源：

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 架构：| 路由 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/stats` | 看板数据；支持 ETag/`304` 与 `?refresh=1` |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/requests` | 分页请求日志；`?offset=0&limit=24` |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/prices` | 可选 OpenRouter 在线价目；`?models=a,b&refresh=1` |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/health` | 存活状态、API 版本和当前 revision |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/verify` | 与官方 `tokenUsage` 投影的诊断对比 |
@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 架构：存在 Host Connection 时，所有路由都会复用其鉴权，并返回 `Cache-Control: no-store`；只有 `/stats` 带弱 ETag。接口不会暴露 prompt、assistant 文本、工具参数、凭据或文件内容。

pnpm typecheck    # Host、Client、Test 三套类型检查
pnpm test         # 87 个测试：单元、路由、SSR、jsdom、bundle

`pnpm verify:real` 需要已构建产物和本地会话日志；修改 fold 时优先运行它。

```text
src/host      会话源、Token fold、聚合、价目、HTTP 路由
src/client    React 界面、DSH Slot、hooks、主题 Token 样式

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · 已知限制：- 只覆盖当前 DSH profile 的本地会话存储；远程、云端和其他 profile 的会话不包含在内。
- 首次打开会把历史扫描进内存缓存。DSH 重启后缓存清空，没有持久化索引。
- 请求速度和首字依赖日志中的 stream 时间戳；旧日志或没有 stream 的请求显示 `—`。
- 费用是以 USD 计的列表价估算，不是账单。内置快照日期为 **2026-10-30**；在线刷新和用户覆盖会改变估算结果。
- 会话跳转依赖可选的 `uiWorkspace.openSession` 宿主服务。

中文 · English

dsh-token-dashboard

Usage, cost, and request latency for every DeepSeek Harness session.

A local-first Cordis plugin that turns local DSH session history into a native dashboard.
@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Introduction：

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Introduction：

Features · Quick start · Usage · Architecture · Development

---

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Overview：DSH already shows token usage for the session in front of you. It does not show the whole picture: every project, model, subagent, fork, and request across your local history.

`@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard` adds that missing layer as a native plugin, displayed as **Token usage** in DSH.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Overview：The Host half reads session logs through the official `sessionPersistence` service and folds them with the same four-bucket accounting used by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter`. The Client half registers a `main` panel and a sidebar-footer entry using DSH slots, then renders with the host React runtime and theme tokens.

The plugin never writes a session log, changes a model request, or uploads session data. The logs remain the only source of truth.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Features：- **Global usage in one view** — totals, uncached input, output, cache read/write, request count, cache hit rate, and session counts across all sessions in the active profile.
- **Range-aware trends** — today, last 7 / 30 / 90 days, all time, or a custom date range; KPIs and the Usage chart share the same range.
- **Models and sessions** — searchable, filterable, sortable tables with pagination and a session detail drawer.
- **Request log** — one row per billed request, with time, app, provider, model, new input, output, cache hit, cost, speed, and first-token latency.
- **Cost estimates** — a built-in 357-model OpenRouter snapshot plus hand-maintained DeepSeek peak rates; override any price locally, or refresh from OpenRouter on demand.
- **Native and local-first** — DSH slots, DSH theme tokens, English/中文 UI, same-origin read-only routes, and exports that strip the working directory.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Quick start：The package name is **`@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard`**. For now, build from source and install it as a local bundle as described below. The unscoped `dsh-token-dashboard` package on npm belongs to another project; do not use `npm install dsh-token-dashboard` to install this plugin.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Requirements：- A DeepSeek Harness installation with the Web UI. Verified on DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.3` (Cordis `4.0.5`).
- Node.js **22.18 or newer** and `pnpm` when building from source.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Build：```bash
git clone https://github.com/shi-YangYang/dsh-token-dashboard.git
cd dsh-token-dashboard
pnpm install
```

`pnpm install` automatically builds the Host and Client through `prepare`, generating the uncommitted `lib/` and `client/` outputs. Run `pnpm build` to rebuild after changing the source.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Install into DSH：Install this directory as a local bundle from DSH's **Plugins** interface, or from a DSH agent:

```text
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "/absolute/path/to/dsh-token-dashboard")
```

Enable the bundle if your profile has it disabled, then refresh the DSH Web page. Open **Token usage** from the sidebar footer, above Settings.

Updating Host code requires a DSH restart; Client-only changes need a page refresh.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Usage：| Page | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Overview** | Global KPIs and a Usage chart across the selected range |
| **Models** | Token distribution and request counts by provider/model |
| **Sessions** | Search, filters, sorting, pagination, and per-session detail |
| **Request log** | Individual billed requests, 12 per page, newest first |
| **Costs** | Estimated spend, per-model breakdown, pricing overrides, and online price refresh |

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Usage：The header provides the language switch, scan interval, **Sync now**, and export. Scan interval controls local session polling: **5 / 10 / 30 / 60 seconds**. All list tables show up to 12 rows per page with compact natural row heights; pagination stays at the footer and no list introduces an inner scrollbar.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Usage：Request-log cost is calculated with the current pricing table in the browser; unpriced models show `—`. Speed is output tokens divided by the measured request window. First-token latency runs from `step/start` to the first stream record; requests without stream timing show `—`.

Prices are estimates, not provider invoices. The built-in DeepSeek rates are peak-hour prices; off-peak rates are approximately half. Overrides and online price cache live in the browser's `localStorage`.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Architecture：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Logs[(Session logs)] --> Host[Host aggregator]
  Live[session/event] --> Host
  Host --> Fold[Token fold + revision cache]

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Architecture：Usage follows the published `tokenUsage` semantics: four disjoint provider buckets, final samples replacing stream samples for the same attempt, retries opening a new attempt, and inherited fork prefixes excluded from totals. See [`src/host/fold.ts`](./src/host/fold.ts) for the implementation.

The HTTP surface is read-only and same-origin:

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Architecture：| Route | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/stats` | Dashboard payload; supports ETag/`304` and `?refresh=1` |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/requests` | Paginated request log; `?offset=0&limit=24` |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/prices` | Optional OpenRouter prices; `?models=a,b&refresh=1` |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/health` | Liveness, API version, and current revision |
| `GET /dsh-token-dashboard/verify` | Diagnostic comparison with the official `tokenUsage` projection |

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Architecture：All routes use the Host Connection gate when available and return `Cache-Control: no-store`; `/stats` is the only route with a weak ETag. No prompts, assistant text, tool arguments, credentials, or file contents are exposed.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm build        # Host (tsc) + Client (esbuild)
pnpm typecheck    # Host, Client, and Test type checks
pnpm test         # 87 tests: unit, routes, SSR, jsdom, bundle

`pnpm verify:real` requires built artifacts and local session logs; it is the best check when changing the fold.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Development：```text
src/host      session source, token fold, aggregation, prices, HTTP routes
src/client    React UI, DSH slots, hooks, theme-token styles
src/shared    wire types, pricing, ranges, formatting
test          node:test suites plus SSR/jsdom rendering checks

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Contributing：Issues and pull requests are welcome. Run `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` before submitting; include a regression test for behavior changes and preserve the read-only, no-upload data contract.

@shi-yangyang/dsh-token-dashboard README · Limitations：- Covers the active DSH profile's local session store only; remote, cloud, and other-profile sessions are not included.
- The first dashboard open scans history into an in-memory cache. A DSH restart starts fresh; there is no persistent index.
- Request speed and first-token latency depend on recorded stream timestamps. Older logs, or requests without streams, show `—`.
- Cost is a list-price estimate in USD, not a bill. The built-in snapshot is dated **2026-10-30**; online refresh and user overrides can change the displayed estimate.
- Session navigation depends on the optional `uiWorkspace.openSession` host service.
